questions.question: Identify the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: 'If only I ________ all the time what I know now about budgeting!'
options: knew
would know
had known
had been knowing

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation?
options: If I were you, I would not have accepted that job.
If I was you, I would not have accepted that job.
If I had been you, I would not have accepted that job.
If I became you, I would not have accepted that job.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would not have accepted that job.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences demonstrates a correct use of ellipsis?
options: She said she was coming, but he said he wasn't.
She said she was coming, but he said he wasn't too.
She said she was coming, but he said he wasn't either.
She said she was coming, but he said he wasn't still.
questions.answer: She said she was coming, but he said he wasn't either.

questions.question: Select the sentence that correctly employs a cleft sentence to emphasize the location.
options: It was in the garden that we first met.
It was the garden that we first met in.
We first met in the garden, that was.
That was the garden where we first met.
questions.answer: It was in the garden that we first met.

questions.question: Choose the correct form to complete the sentence: 'Had he known the consequences, he ________ the risky investment.'
options: might not have made
might not make
mightn't have made
mightn't make
